LESSON: VOLLEYBALL

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Creating and Executing
Topic 1.3: Volleyball
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Volleyball, part of Creating and Executing in Grade 6 CREATIVE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: How can service skills in Volleyball be used to win a game?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch a real or virtual Volleyball game responsibly to identify serving and digging skills,

2. demonstrate the under-arm service,

3. practise the under-arm in volleyball game,

4. demonstrate the single hand dig pass in volleyball,

5. practise the single hand dig pass in a game situation,

6. play a Volleyball game while applying the skills learnt and observing safety,

7. share own and others performance in Volleyball game while giving each other feedback.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch a real or virtual Volleyball game responsibly to identify serving and digging skills,
2. demonstrate the under-arm service,
3. practise the under-arm in volleyball game,
4. demonstrate the single hand dig pass in volleyball,
5. practise the single hand dig pass in a game situation,
6. play a Volleyball game while applying the skills learnt and observing safety,
7. share own and others performance in Volleyball game while giving each other feedback.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Volleyball together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learnin to learn: The learner acquires new skills of serving and the single hand dig pass in Volleyball game.

• Digital literacy: The learner uses digital technology to source virtual Volleyball game to identify under arm serving and

single hand dig skills.

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner searches and watches a virtual Volleyball game to identify serving and digging skills.

• Unity: The learner shares the volleyball equipment as they demonstrate the skills of single hand dig pass and underarm

service.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Safety and security: The learner plays a Volleyball game while applying the skills learnt and observing safety.

Link to other learning areas:

Integrated Science: The learners applies force while serving the Volleyball.
